rounds.hypothesis: Prepending a 'look around' exploration instruction to the system prompt and suggesting 'look' as the first action will help agents discover object locations faster, reducing failed examine/take attempts and improving pass rates on object-finding tasks.
Exposing admissible_commands() as a native tool and nudging agents to call it after an empty look will reduce wasted exploration steps and improve pass rates.

Adding a structured exploration strategy that systematically checks nearby locations before attempting object interactions will reduce wasted exploration steps and improve pass rates on object-finding tasks.

Adding a structured exploration phase that systematically checks nearby locations and uses admissible_commands early will reduce wasted exploration steps and improve pass rates on object-finding and placement tasks.
